verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows that Bitwarden's Public API lets organizations manage 'members, collections, groups, event logs, and policies,' implying policy management exists, but there is no documentation shown for specific policies like app-lock enforcement, export restriction, or master-password strength requirements. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of individual policy types (master password strength, disable personal vault export, require app lock/timeout), admin console UI screenshots or workflow, and any hands-on confirmation that these policies are enforced across all members' apps.
